objections.claim: The Lane P enumeration lost its change-control clause in the conversion to a partial order, so the node set can now be edited without a successor.
objections.evidence: Measured: the draft contains zero occurrences of 'count-pinned' or 'successor required'. The turn-2 draft read 'Lane P, in this order (count-pinned at five; successor required to change it)', and the CONTESTED D-031 and D-024 carried the same construction. The turn-3 node set is P1, P2, P3, P4a, P4b, P4c, P5 — seven nodes and two edges — with no pin and no successor clause on either. This matters a little more than usual because the header's own decision-type line names 'the Lane P partial order below' as one of the two preference choices this entry makes, so the graph is the preference-laden content and now carries no visible amendment control. I do not score it: D-000's status vocabulary already makes an adopted entry changeable only by SUPERSEDED or OVERTURNED, so the general protocol supplies change control and the explicit clause was belt-and-braces. I also raised precisely this at C2N1-D031-01 in the earlier cycle as a NOTE, and scoring it higher here would be inconsistent on unchanged reasoning.
objections.proposedFix: Restore the clause in a form that fits a graph rather than a list, for example: node set and edges pinned at seven nodes and two edges; changing either requires a successor or supersession of this entry.

Two edges over seven nodes cannot form a cycle, and neither does: the graph is acyclic by inspection. A relabelled total order would need six edges chaining every node; there are two. The entry also states the negative directly: 'There is no "step 4 after steps 1–3" total order.'

Both edges are individually justified rather than asserted. P1 to P5 is reasoned — 'what analyze evaluates is a product fact'. The absence of a P4a/P4b to P5 edge is reasoned and checkable — 'unless those dispositions' adopted selectors name a required analyze fact, which D-028/D-029 do not' — and the adopted D-028 and D-029 entries in the register concern DR-005's V10/custody/G19 and DR-008's integration half respectively, neither naming an analyze fact.

The adopted D-030 decision text scopes the TM to 'every boundary D-002 ships … (hostile repository/source, parser/provider admission, four-platform matrix, first-install trust, doctor, signed delivery, Node closure)', and DR-003's acceptance cell reads 'Reviewed closure of V10/custody and G19, publication block satisfied by required demonstration, final disposition'.
